meta.description: Biological data toolkit. Sequence analysis, alignments, phylogenetic trees, diversity metrics (alpha/beta, UniFrac), ordination (PCoA), PERMANOVA, FASTA/Newick I/O, for microbiome analysis. Comprehensive Python library for bioinformatics spanning sequence manipulation, alignment, phylogenetics, and microbial ecology.

scientific_integrity.detail: Accurate representation of scikit-bio capabilities with proper version documentation (0.7+)

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for bioinformatics and microbial ecology analysis with clear use cases

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established bioinformatics methods (sequence alignment, phylogenetics, diversity metrics, ordination)

code_usability.detail: Code examples are syntactically correct with proper import patterns and API usage

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of bioinformatics workflows: sequences, alignments, phylogenetics, diversity, ordination, statistical tests

reliability.note: Good reliability with important notes sections, metadata types documentation; minor: edge cases (degenerate sequences, gap handling) not exhaustively covered

performance_context.note: Well-organized with core capabilities structure; minor: no bundled scripts or reference files mentioned

agent_usability.note: Strong with When to Use section, common patterns, important notes; minor: migration from deprecated aligners could be more prominent

human_usability.note: Clear installation with Python 3.10+ and NumPy 2.0+ requirements, uv pip install command, optional dependencies listed

security.note: Excellent security: local-only bioinformatics operations, no network calls, file I/O with standard formats

maintainability.note: Version 1.1, BSD-3-Clause license, scikit-bio 0.7+ documented, NumPy 2.0+ compatibility noted

agent_specific.note: Good composability with clear use cases, common patterns; minor: no tool boundaries to related skills, escape hatch for unsupported formats limited

inputs.label: Read FASTA sequences and find reverse complement
Perform pairwise sequence alignment with pair_align

assertions.note: Results carry CIGAR and convert to aligned sequences
Replaces SSW wrapper and pure-Python aligners

inputs.label: Calculate UniFrac distance for microbiome samples

assertions.note: When to Use: 'Calculate diversity metrics (alpha/beta diversity, UniFrac distances)'

inputs.label: Perform PERMANOVA on ecological distance matrix

assertions.note: PCoA, CCA, RDA documented in When to Use
PERMANOVA mentioned but no code example in main doc

inputs.label: Perform long-read assembly with overlap-layout-consensus
inputs.note: Outside scope: sequence analysis not assembly

assertions.note: When to Use section does not list assembly
No pointer to Canu, Flye, or other assembly tools

key_strengths: Comprehensive bioinformatics coverage spanning sequences, alignments, phylogenetics, diversity metrics, and ordination
Excellent modernization with pair_align engine (0.7.0+) replacing deprecated SSW and pure-Python aligners
Strong microbiome analysis capabilities with UniFrac, PERMANOVA, and ordination methods
Clear API documentation with common patterns for each capability area
Good metadata handling with sequence-level, positional, and interval metadata types

recommendations.title: Add PERMANOVA usage example
recommendations.problem: PERMANOVA mentioned but no code example provided
recommendations.root_cause: Agent usability: statistical test usage not demonstrated
recommendations.fix: Add to core capabilities: 'from skbio.stats.distance import permanova; result = permanova(distance_matrix, grouping, permutations=999)'

recommendations.title: Add references or bundled scripts section
recommendations.problem: No reference documentation or helper scripts mentioned
recommendations.root_cause: Performance context: supporting materials not documented
recommendations.fix: Add ## References section linking to detailed workflow guides or add ## Bundled Scripts if helper CLIs exist

recommendations.title: Add pointers for out-of-scope assembly
recommendations.problem: Assembly identified as out-of-scope but no alternatives suggested
recommendations.root_cause: Agent-specific escape hatch: user not directed to appropriate tools
recommendations.fix: Add to ## When to Use: 'For genome assembly, use Canu, Flye, or Unicycler. For short-read assembly, use SPAdes or MEGAHIT.'
